decisions.reason: A multi-model lever handle family close to the core range is cheap to keep in the catalogue and serves ongoing project business, so dropping it is unlikely despite the missing website data after 2019.
A single handle design carries some risk of being pruned in range updates, but it was still listed in 2019 and handle designs in this industry typically stay available for many years.
The L700 LightAccess electronic access system is a flagship that fits the firm's strategic push into digital building organization, so it will be kept and developed further.
